name: docx4j-ts-editor
description: A web docx editor over @docx4j/core-ts: the headless projection (@docx4j/editor-model), the application (@docx4j/editor), the co-editing relay (@docx4j/editor-relay) and the MCP companion (@docx4j/editor-mcp). docs/developer/architecture.md is the design.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run typecheck -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run typecheck -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run typecheck -w @docx4j/editor-mcp && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-mcp && npm run typecheck -w @docx4j/editor
scripts.test: npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run test -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run test -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run test -w @docx4j/editor && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-mcp && npm run test -w @docx4j/editor-mcp
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @docx4j/editor
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run dev -w @docx4j/editor
scripts.locales:check: npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-model && npm run build -w @docx4j/editor-relay && npm run locales:check -w @docx4j/editor
scripts.word-session: npm run build && node packages/editor-mcp/scripts/review-for-word.mjs && node packages/editor-model/test/fixtures/build/measure-base.mjs && node packages/editor-model/test/fixtures/build/ids-for-word.mjs
